types.explanation: Status-Code 100 (Continue) – Informational: request received, continuing process.
Status-Code 200 (OK) – Success: action successfully received, understood, and accepted.
Status-Code 301 (Moved Permanently) – Redirection: requested resource moved permanently.
Status-Code 302 (Found) – Redirection: requested resource found under a different URI.
Status-Code 303 (See Other) – Redirection: not used in RTSP 2.0, but defined for compatibility.
Status-Code 304 (Not Modified) – Redirection: conditional DESCRIBE/SETUP indicates resource unchanged.
Status-Code 305 (Use Proxy) – Redirection: request must be sent through a proxy.
Status-Code 400 (Bad Request) – Client Error: malformed syntax.
Status-Code 401 (Unauthorized) – Client Error: authentication required.
Status-Code 402 (Payment Required) – Client Error: reserved for future use.
Status-Code 403 (Forbidden) – Client Error: request understood but refused.
Status-Code 404 (Not Found) – Client Error: resource not found.
Status-Code 405 (Method Not Allowed) – Client Error: method not allowed for resource.
Status-Code 406 (Not Acceptable) – Client Error: response content unacceptable per Accept headers.
Status-Code 407 (Proxy Authentication Required) – Client Error: proxy authentication required.
Status-Code 408 (Request Timeout) – Client Error: server timed out waiting for request.
Status-Code 410 (Gone) – Client Error: resource no longer available permanently.
Status-Code 412 (Precondition Failed) – Client Error: precondition given in If-* headers failed.
Status-Code 413 (Request Message Body Too Large) – Client Error: request body too large.
Status-Code 414 (Request-URI Too Long) – Client Error: Request-URI too long.
Status-Code 415 (Unsupported Media Type) – Client Error: unsupported media type in request body.
Status-Code 451 (Parameter Not Understood) – Client Error: parameter not understood.
Status-Code 452 (Reserved) – reserved status code.
Status-Code 453 (Not Enough Bandwidth) – Client Error: insufficient bandwidth.
Status-Code 454 (Session Not Found) – Client Error: session identifier invalid or timed out.
Status-Code 455 (Method Not Valid in This State) – Client Error: method not valid in current state.
Status-Code 456 (Header Field Not Valid for Resource) – Client Error: header field not valid for resource.
Status-Code 457 (Invalid Range) – Client Error: range invalid for the media.
Status-Code 458 (Parameter Is Read-Only) – Client Error: parameter read-only.
Status-Code 459 (Aggregate Operation Not Allowed) – Client Error: operation not allowed on aggregate URI.
Status-Code 460 (Only Aggregate Operation Allowed) – Client Error: only aggregate operation allowed.
Status-Code 461 (Unsupported Transport) – Client Error: unsupported transport specification.
Status-Code 462 (Destination Unreachable) – Client Error: destination unreachable.
Status-Code 463 (Destination Prohibited) – Client Error: destination prohibited.
Status-Code 464 (Data Transport Not Ready Yet) – Client Error: data transport not ready.
Status-Code 465 (Notification Reason Unknown) – Client Error: notification reason unknown.
Status-Code 466 (Key Management Error) – Client Error: key management error.
Status-Code 470 (Connection Authorization Required) – Client Error: connection authorization required.
Status-Code 471 (Connection Credentials Not Accepted) – Client Error: connection credentials not accepted.
Status-Code 472 (Failure to Establish Secure Connection) – Client Error: failure to establish secure connection.
Status-Code 500 (Internal Server Error) – Server Error: internal server error.
Status-Code 501 (Not Implemented) – Server Error: method not implemented.
Status-Code 502 (Bad Gateway) – Server Error: bad gateway.
Status-Code 503 (Service Unavailable) – Server Error: service temporarily unavailable.
Status-Code 504 (Gateway Timeout) – Server Error: gateway timeout.
Status-Code 505 (RTSP Version Not Supported) – Server Error: RTSP version not supported.
Status-Code 551 (Option Not Supported) – Server Error: option not supported (feature tag not supported).
Status-Code 553 (Proxy Unavailable) – Server Error: proxy unavailable.
